Identical fiber-cement tread/riser finish spec (1"x12" tread, 1" riser, 0.175m riser heights, 0.25m tread run) to a sister house's equivalent detail -- confirms this is a repeated design-office standard for this house series' main interior stair, applied as a finish layer over the RC structural stair slab (structural stair sheets are outside this assignment's page range).
0.175m riser height matches view1's full-section riser height exactly (18 @ 0.175 = 3.15m total rise) -- internally consistent across all 4 views on this page.
